description: This file defines the AuthenticationManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing authentication providers, handling authentication requests, applying filters, and coordinating challenge responses within the Drupal core authentication system.

classes.name: AuthenticationManager
classes.description: Manages authentication providers, determines applicable providers for requests, and handles authentication and challenge logic within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AuthenticationManager with an AuthenticationCollectorInterface instance.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Checks if any provider applies to the given request.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate the request using the appropriate provider.

methods.name: appliesToRoutedRequest
methods.description: Determines if the request is allowed based on routing and provider filters.

methods.name: challengeException
methods.description: Handles challenge exceptions by delegating to the appropriate provider.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the first applicable provider ID for the request.

methods.name: getChallenger
methods.description: Retrieves the provider ID responsible for challenge responses.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Checks if a provider is permitted for the request based on filters.

methods.name: defaultFilter
methods.description: Default filter logic based on route options and global provider set.
